title: Stemness-based gastric cancer classification by machine learning for precision diagnosis and treatment of gastric cancer.
summary: OCLR stemness scores and consensus clustering in 389 TCGA gastric cancers defined two subtypes; a 12-gene ML model was checked on an external cohort. Predicted immunotherapy/chemotherapy differences are in-silico and not measured treatment responses. The result is reported in Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
